name: mocapi-apps-dev-host
description: Dev host that renders mocapi MCP Apps (ui://) end-to-end over MCP 2026-07-28

scripts.build: cross-env INPUT=index.html vite build && cross-env INPUT=sandbox.html vite build
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "cross-env NODE_ENV=development INPUT=index.html vite build --watch" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development INPUT=sandbox.html vite build --watch" "tsx serve.ts"
